headline: Spatial omics methods couple histology with molecular profiles at subcellular resolution
label: Histology Integrated Spatial Omics
summary: Multiple new tools integrate histology or morphology with spatial transcriptomic and proteomic measurements across platforms and tissue scales.
synthesis: The dominant thread is coupling morphological or histological context to molecular measurements at cellular and subcellular resolution. SpaReg reconstructs 3D tissue from histology, spatial proteomics and transcriptomics while preserving subcellular morphology across sections, and spEnhance uses histology and scRNA-seq references to push spot-level spatial omics toward super-resolution, with count-splitting supporting trustworthy reconstruction. MSI.EAGLE's landmark-free Histology Fit applies a related histology-alignment step to subcellular DESI-MSI on stock hardware. At the transcript level, MCseg applies AI-agent-guided workflow search to Xenium segmentation and transcript attribution, and SpatialTRACE extends sparse annotations into anatomical axis and region maps. A benchmark of 371 count-matrix preprocessing workflows across 45 datasets from 11 platforms yields platform-specific recommendations. Other items address adjacent problems, including cell-cell communication inference (SpaHCC, SpiderNet) and deconvolution (STGnet). The axillary node CT study has no spatial omics premise.
